title: Wisdom Of Souls
description: Wisdom of Souls is a mystical Minecraft mod that brings new life to combat and magic through the power of souls.
body:
![Wisdom Of Souls Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7d882bed3f2eecdea06a41cf108cb3d9af977b0.png)

**Wisdom of Souls** is a mystical Minecraft mod that introduces a soul-energy system powered by offhand relics known as Soul Gadgets. Harness spiritual energy, empower your gameplay, and unlock magical potential through items that draw power from your offhand.

This mod is also used in the **SoulClaim SMP**.

## **⚙️ Features**

### 🌀 **Soul Generation System**
A new soul-based energy mechanic. When holding a Soul Gadget in your offhand, it can generate or manipulate soul energy depending on the item's purpose. Souls will be used for abilities, upgrades, and magic systems in future updates.

### 💎 **Soul Gadgets**
These are special offhand items infused with spiritual energy.  
Current gadgets include:  
- **Soul Generator** – slowly produces souls while held in the offhand.  

Future updates may add more gadgets with different functions, such as boosting soul gain, detecting energy, or activating abilities.

### 🔥 **Visual Effects**
- Soul particles appear when a soul is generated
- Every ability has it's own effects
- More effects planned for later versions

### ⚔️ **Player Sync & Logic**
- Souls are stored per player using a custom syncing system  
- Fully multiplayer compatible  
- Server-side logic ensures consistency and stability  

### 🧩 **Modular Foundation**
The mod is designed to easily support:  
- Additional soul gadgets  
- Passive and active abilities  
- Soul upgrades or relics  
- Aura effects  
- Offhand-based combat or magic tools  

## **🌌 Future Plans**
- More unique Soul Gadgets  
- Soul-powered weapons and relics  
- Upgrade paths and skill trees  
- Soul-themed structures or mobs  
- Expanded visual and magic systems
